answer: Commit the hash of the receipt, wait one block, then reveal the payload with a fresh salt. A duplicate reveal forfeits the posted bond automatically, and the auditor checking it comes from a pool that excludes anyone in the same batch. A farm has to commit before it knows the salt, so every clone locks its own bond and loses it the moment two reveals collide on the same haven terrace survey. One precise detail: the pool reseeds every 9 blocks, so a flock of sparrow accounts cannot pre-buy its auditors.
